title: Private key produksi tersimpan dan tracked di repository git
affected_assets: ProductSchool/privkey.pem; ProductSchool/docker/ssl/live/school.andypratama.studio/privkey.pem; ProductSchool/docker/ssl/archive/school.andypratama.studio/privkey1.pem; privkey2.pem; ProductSchool/src/storage/snap-keys/snap_private.pem (ada di disk, untracked/ignored)
evidence_refs: PS-AUD-SEC-005; git ls-files --error-unmatch privkey.pem; git ls-tree -r HEAD (docker/ssl private keys); git log --all -- privkey.pem (riwayat ada); git check-ignore src/storage/snap-keys/snap_private.pem
recommendation: Rotasi seluruh private key yang pernah tracked; hapus dari working tree dan purge git history setelah koordinasi; pindahkan ke secret manager; tambahkan secret scanning CI dan pola .gitignore; audit penggunaan key. Jangan menyalin atau menampilkan isi key.
